After moving to Maine 4 years ago, she completed the esthetician program at Aveda in Augusta and graduated in 2023. “The largest organ is your skin. It’s not necessarily something everyone knows. By becoming an esthetician I hope to help people take better care of what matters most.” Meghan grew up in Massachusetts but Maine has always been home to her. Her summer vacations in Round Pond as a child made it clear that Maine was where she wanted to raise her family. Meghan is thrilled to share her knowledge of skin and beauty with all new and current clients. She looks forward to seeing you at The Skin Klinic.
